title: Missing secure check for __Host- cookies
detail: The condition rejects a cookie if it starts with __secure- or __host- and either is not secure or the request scheme is not https. However, __Host- cookies also require the cookie to be secure. As written, a __Host- cookie that is secure but has an invalid domain or path will incorrectly pass this check and later be accepted, violating the intended restriction.

title: IndexError on empty spans
detail: When a variation selector (\ufe0f) appears at the start of the string, the code enters the else branch where it assumes a previous span exists and accesses spans[-1]. If spans is empty, this raises an IndexError, breaking the function.
